sc2csv-cli %s - Brawl Stars CSV unpacker / packer

Usage:
  sc2csv-cli --decode <input> <output> [options]
  sc2csv-cli --encode <input> <output> [options]
  sc2csv-cli --decode <input> --in-place [options]
  sc2csv-cli --encode <input> --in-place [options]

<input> is a directory: its csv_logic, csv_client and localization folders are
scanned, or every .csv below it when those folders are absent. A single .csv
file is accepted too.

Options:
  --decode        unpack containers to plain CSV
  --encode        pack plain CSV into containers
  --overwrite     overwrite existing output files (default: skip them)
  --flat          do not keep the input's subdirectories under <output>
  --in-place      write back over the input files; no <output> is needed
  -q, --quiet     print only failures and the summary
  -h, --help      show this help
  --version       show the version
  --lang <code>   interface language: zh-cn, en-us, ja-jp

Exit status:
  0  all files converted or skipped
  1  at least one file failed
  2  invalid arguments, or the input could not be scanned
